prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Choose How to Meet Your Desktop Pet", "Select a ready-to-play companion or create a custom pet from your own photos.", "Path Selection"]
1: ["Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop!", "Your desktop companion is ready to hang out.", "Start Playing", "Learn Desktop Commands", "Try right-clicking or dragging your companion around the screen.", "Got It!"]
2: ["Save Your New Desktop Companion", "Sign in to backup your pet settings and sync across devices.", "Save & Continue"]
3: ["Customize Pet Appearance", "Tailor your pet's fur, colors, and accessories.", "Select Features"]
4: ["Hatching Your Pet...", "We are assembling your pet's unique personality.", "Did you know desktop pets gain happiness when you move your mouse near them?"]
5: ["Secure Your Pet Cloud Backup", "Link an account now so your pet companion is safe and never reset.", "Your account keeps your pet saved even if you reinstall."]
6: ["Use clear, well-lit photos facing forward for best rendering results.", "Tip: Bright natural lighting produces the best custom pet model!"]
7: ["Meet Your Desktop Companion!", "Your pet is ready to live on your screen.", "Spawn Pet Now"]
8: ["Free Starter Toy Included"]
9: ["You can minimize the window; we will notify you when your pet is ready!"]
